targets.rawSql: SELECT $timeSeries as t, sum(Sum) as "Total Tokens" FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, sum(Sum) as "Input Tokens" FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'input' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, sum(Sum) as "Output Tokens" FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' AND Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT sumIf(Sum, Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'output') / nullIf(sumIf(Sum, Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] = 'input'), 0) as ratio FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, sum(Sum) as tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider) GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] as provider, sum(Sum) as tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) GROUP BY provider ORDER BY tokens DESC

panels.title: Input vs Output Tokens Over Time

targets.rawSql: $columns(Attributes['gen_ai.token.type'] as token_type, sum(Sum) as tokens) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) GROUP BY t, token_type ORDER BY t

$increase(Value) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost' $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] IN (${model:singlequote}), $model) $conditionalTest(AND Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)

SELECT c.total_cost / nullIf(r.requests, 0) as avg_cost FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as total_cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost') c, (SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') r

SELECT (argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix)) / nullIf(toFloat64(max(TimeUnix) - min(TimeUnix)), 0) * 86400 as daily_rate FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost'

SELECT c.total_cost / nullIf(t.total_tokens, 0) * 1000 as cost_per_1k FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as total_cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost') c, (SELECT sum(Sum) as total_tokens FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage') t

SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.request.model'] as model, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost' GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] as provider, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix) as cost FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost' GROUP BY provider ORDER BY cost DESC

$increaseColumns(Attributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] as provider, Value) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.cost'
SELECT count() as tool_calls FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool'
SELECT countIf(has(Events.Name, 'tool_execution_failed')) as tool_failures FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant'
SELECT count() as retrievals FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'retrieval'

SELECT avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'])) as avg_chunks FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'retrieval' AND SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'] != ''
SELECT countIf(has(Events.Name, 'rag_retrieval_degraded')) as rag_degraded FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant'

panels.title: Tool Calls Over Time by Tool

targets.rawSql: $columns(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] as tool, count() as cnt) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] != '' GROUP BY t, tool ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'])) as avg_chunks FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'retrieval' AND SpanAttributes['app.retrieval.chunk_count'] != '' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'
SELECT avg(Duration / 1000000000) as avg_duration_s FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'

SELECT quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1000000000) as p99_s FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'

SELECT 1 - countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as success_rate FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent'

panels.title: Tool Latency by Tool Over Time

targets.rawSql: $columns(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] as tool, avg(Duration / 1000000) as avg_ms) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] != '' GROUP BY t, tool ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as error_rate FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] as tool, count() as calls, quantile(0.5)(Duration / 1000000) as p50, quantile(0.9)(Duration / 1000000) as p90, quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1000000) as p99, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') as errors, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) as error_pct FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] != '' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC
$increase(Value) FROM infraspec.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND MetricName = 'gen_ai.client.error.count'

SELECT SpanAttributes['error.type'] as error_type, count() as cnt FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != '' GROUP BY error_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] as provider, count() as errors FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '' GROUP BY provider ORDER BY errors DESC

$columns(SpanAttributes['error.type'] as error_type, count() as cnt) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != '' GROUP BY t, error_type ORDER BY t
SELECT avg(Duration / 1000000) as avg_ms FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql'

SELECT d.db_spans / nullIf(p.requests, 0) as queries_per_request FROM (SELECT count() as db_spans FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql') d, (SELECT count() as requests FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') p
SELECT quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1000000) as p99_ms FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql'
SELECT countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') as db_errors FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql'

SELECT $timeSeries as t, avg(Duration / 1000000) as db_avg_ms FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT $timeSeries as t, avg(Duration / 1000000000) as request_avg_s FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

$columns(SpanAttributes['db.operation'] as op, avg(Duration / 1000000) as avg_ms) FROM infraspec.otel_traces WHERE $timeFilter AND ServiceName = 'ai-runbook-assistant' AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] = 'postgresql' AND SpanAttributes['db.operation'] != '' GROUP BY t, op ORDER BY t
